en: This is the chapel! It's a mess, huh?

Nyeeeh... Searching this place 
is gonna be pretty hard.

Now that we've checked out all the important
places in the Virtual World...

Let's split up and look for this <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of
the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

Oh, so we're splitting up, huh?
That's probably better.

I wonder what the <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>
could be...

Monokuma did not give us much information
about it, either.

Are we going to be able to find it
if we don't know what it is?

There's no point in asking whether we'll find
it or not! We just gotta do it!
Yeah, that's right!

Just keep an eye out for anything suspicious,
and it's bound to turn up!

It sounds like we have a difficult task ahead
of us...but I guess we have to see it through.

Oh, yeah... Before we split up, I wanna ask
you something, Miu.
What are you two whispering about?

Mind your business, titless! Quit stickin'
your pot belly where it doesn't belong!

I-I don't have a pot belly!
I definitely don't have a pot belly!
But you're not denying that first part...?
So, who's going to decide how we split up?

Just leave it all to me! I'll figure out how
everyone should split up in a flash!
No, no! Hold up! I'll decide that!

I know this world better than any of you,
so I'll decide!
O-Oh... You sure?

Kaito, I want you to search the rooftop of
the mansion!

Huh!? Why do I gotta go up to the rooftop!?
It's freakin' cold out there!

Yeah! There's no way the faint-hearted
Kaito can search in the cold!

Alright! Bring it on! All I gotta do 
is search the rooftop, right?

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito and Kokichi...really don't
seem to get along.
Kokichi... You're in charge of the salon.
O-kay! Got it.

We need about three more people to search
the mansion. Doesn't matter who.

This plan became pretty sloppy 
all of a sudden.
Then Gonta should come with me.

We can search the <CLT=cltSTRONG>mansion's surroundings<CLT=cltNORMAL>,
since no one else wants to deal with the cold.
Okay...Gonta come with you.

Mm-hm, a true gentleman must always
volunteer to do the dirty work.
So...you're just going to use Gonta again.

I've decided! I'm going that way too! I have 
to make sure you're not abusing poor Gonta!

We still need one more for mansion duty.
Shuichi, come with us.
Ah, okay...

<CLT=cltMIND>Is Maki upset...?
Because she's all by herself now?

<CLT=cltMIND>...Even if I asked her, I suspect she
would just ask me if I wanted to die again.
<CLT=cltMIND>I should keep quiet for now.

Alright! Everyone else, stick with me here
in the chapel and look for the secret!
So Himiko, Maki, Miu and myself. Understood.

Let's go back to the mansion. We gotta find
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Do a good job, Maki Roll!

Hey, is Maki Roll mad?
Shuichi, did you do something?
I-I don't know, I...

Shuichi, what did you do to Maki Roll?
If you know, you better apologize, okay?
Y-Yeah...

So Gonta gonna search mansion over there,
right? Okay, let's go Shuichi.

Kokichi Oma
Leaving Chapel Area

Leave this side to us. We'll leave the other
side to you.

...And we should probably keep an eye on
Kokichi, just in case.
Good idea. I'll be careful.

Nyeeeh, so we're searching here. It's gonna take
a lot of effort since I can't use my magic...
<CLT=cltMIND>She's...actually mad.

We'll search the mansion. It's plain to see
it'll be a lot of work, but let's do our best.
Well? Isn't this world just the best!?

How does expanding this place and making
it our <CLT=cltSTRONG>new reality<CLT=cltNORMAL> sound to you guys?

Your bodies may be confined...but here, your
mind is free!

Isn't that more like
*escaping* reality?

...That is illogical. This is hardly the time to
retreat from reality.

Living in a game world seems like an interesting
idea, but...I wouldn't want to be here forever.

I don't like the cold. It'd be better if this
Virtual World was a tropical island.
I mean, my face isn't this ugly!
Wh-What the fuck, guys!? Seriously...!?
You're gonna regret this!

What are you, stupid? 
I'm already regretting this!
I shouldn't have...come here.

Now now, everyone. I know it's not great here,
but let's just start searching.
Ugh...grghggh! I-I'll make you regret this!

<CLT=cltMIND>Regret this? What does she mean?
She says such ominous things...

<CLT=cltMIND>I suppose it makes sense for
a chapel to have an organ.

<CLT=cltMIND>...Kaede probably could have
played the organ well too.
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>Sure is messy in here...

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a mountain of books and posters,
and what looks like Christmas decorations...

<CLT=cltMIND>Was this meant to hide the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltMIND>?
<CLT=cltMIND>That's something Monokuma would do...

Shuichi! We'll take care of searching around
the chapel!

I will show you that I'm leagues apart from
those household cleaning robots!
Ah, okay. I'll leave the chapel to you, Keebo.
<CLT=cltMIND>Sure is messy in here...

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a mountain of books and posters,
and what looks like Christmas decorations...

<CLT=cltMIND>Was this meant to hide the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltMIND>?
<CLT=cltMIND>That's something Monokuma would do...

Nyeeeh...
I'm already tired...

Shuichi, if you want to help,
don't hold back, okay?

Ah, I was just taking a look around...
I'll go investigate the mansion.
